plan.title: bug(design-critique): copyable brief template and skill omit the pain field so Stop 1 inherits missing-pain

narratives.Description: bug(design-critique): copyable brief template and skill omit the pain field so Stop 1 inherits missing-pain
narratives.Overview:
- Recut P1 to one hole: the copyable envelope fields list has no Stop 1 `pain:` closed form, and `REQUIRED_TEMPLATE_POINTERS` does not lock it. Pointer-to-heading work on the template and skill is already landed. Recut "every arc inherits missing-pain" to "a template-faithful Stop 1 omits the bind conjunct."
- Add an envelope field parallel to Audit targets, inverted: copy onto the Stop 1 write-back (`role: triage`) as an operative line-start in the published closed forms (`pain: P1` / `pain: P1, P2` / `pain:` then `- P1`). Do not copy onto critic comments. One sentence that this is not `audit-targets` / `pain-P1`.
- Strike AC 2 as a skill markdown table. Add a closed-form Stop 1 `pain:` token to `REQUIRED_TEMPLATE_POINTERS`. If the skill needs a heading token, add `Pain coverage` to `REQUIRED_SKILL_POINTERS` via `content/packs/skills/skills-pack-0.1.json`, not the rendered SKILL.md.
- Do not change `applyPainCoverage`. Do not auto-invent ids from the because-clause.

Footnotes stay footnotes: #3007 critic 5666010600 finding 2 is not template evidence.
